_why: pointlessbutton is a ~511k-line Django 6 + vanilla-JS competitive clicking game (Redis-first, Celery, Stripe, Vite-bundled frontend, heavy custom Django admin). The scan ran in degraded mode (could not import myproject, routes read from source) and produced 3862 claims across 10 kinds; I judged 103 (seed-0 sample of up to 12 per kind) by opening each claimed file/line and grepping the repo for the counterpart end. Overall precision 33/103 (~32%). Dominant false-positive causes: admin templates styled by pb-admin_v3.css linked in an ancestor base template (covers ~3355 of 3362 dom_attr claims), runtime-built Django admin URL names claimed unresolved despite the tool knowing it could not see them, delete() calls misread as writes (all 8 redis_ttl claims), and Redis keys read through local variables/wrappers/Lua EVAL.
